name: Inverse Mean Residual Color (IMRC) Metric
definition: A metric to evaluate geometry quality by measuring the transmittance-density-weighted residual color in dB. Higher IMRC indicates better geometry.
summary: The Inverse Mean Residual Color metric evaluates radiance field geometry quality without ground-truth data by measuring transmittance-density-weighted color residuals, unlike PSNR or Chamfer Distance.
